text: Integers: Evaluate the addition of directed numbers: (-14) + (50) = ? (Class 7 #1)
explanation: [CBSE Class 7 Syllabus] Subtract absolute values and retain sign of larger magnitude: (-14) + (50) = 36.
hint: Find the difference between their absolute values.

text: Linear Equations: Solve for unknown variable x in: 5x + 33 = 93 (Class 7 #2)
explanation: [ICSE Class 7 Syllabus] 5x = 93 - 33 = 60 => x = 60 / 5 = 12.
hint: Subtract the constant, then divide by the coefficient.

text: Percentages: Calculate 10% of ₹1400 (Commercial Math #3, Class 7):
explanation: [IGCSE Class 7 Syllabus] (10 / 100) × 1400 = ₹140.
hint: Multiply amount by percentage / 100.

text: Geometry: In triangle ABC, angle A = 44° and angle B = 51°. What is angle C (Class 7 #4)?
explanation: [CBSE Class 7 Syllabus] Angle sum property: Angle C = 180° - (44° + 51°) = 85°.
hint: Sum of angles in any triangle is 180°.

text: Algebraic Identities: Expand and evaluate using (a + b)²: (5 + 4)² = ? (Class 7 #5)

text: Geometry: In triangle ABC, angle A = 47° and angle B = 56°. What is angle C (Class 8 #4)?

hint: Sum of angles in any triangle is 180°.

text: Arithmetic Progressions: Find the 9th term (a_9) of the AP with first term a = 14 and common difference d = 7 (Class 9 #2):
explanation: [ICSE Class 9 Syllabus] a_n = a + (n - 1)d = 14 + (9 - 1)(7) = 14 + 8 × 7 = 70.
hint: Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1)d.

text: Trigonometry: In right-angled triangle ABC, if sin(A) = 15/17, find the exact value of cos(A) (Class 9 Trigonometry #3):
explanation: [IGCSE Class 9 Syllabus] cos(A) = √(1 - sin²A) = √(1 - (15/17)²) = √(64/289) = 8/17.
